comment: cmd.c rhack() clears context.travel and travel1 for every keyed command. The hero stands in an open doorway and travels to the diagonal square inside the room: findtravelpath()'s adjacent fast path calls end_running(FALSE), which zeroes multi but keeps context.travel, and the one ordinary step that follows leaves context.run at 8. The counted search then starts with travel cleared, so allmain.c moveloop_core()'s seventh-step arm tests multi (14) rather than moves, marks the status line dirty, and the turn counter is redrawn once. Options time and runmode:teleport admit that arm. Variation: counted-search-after-adjacent-travel-count-8.
